params.name: state
params.description: The state of the service

params.name: serviceDate.lt
params.description: Less than the date when the service was created (whatever its status)

params.name: serviceDate.gt
params.description: Greater than the date when the service was created (whatever its status)

params.name: startDate.lt
params.description: Less than the date when the service starts

params.name: startDate.gt
params.description: Greater than the date when the service starts

params.name: endDate.lt
params.description: Less than the date when the service ends

params.name: endDate.gt
params.description: Greater than the date when the service ends

params.name: serviceOrder.id
params.description: A reference to a service order related to this service. Must be used together with serviceOrderItem.id

params.name: serviceOrderItem.id
params.description: A reference to a service order item related to this service. Must be used together with serviceOrder.id

params.name: externalId
params.description: An externalId provided in the service order

params.name: geographicSite.id
params.description: A GeographicSite identifier which is associated to this service

params.name: geographicAddress.id
params.description: A GeographicAddress identifier which is associated to this service

params.name: serviceType
params.description: Business type of the service

params.name: @type
params.description: The `@type` of `MefServiceConfiguration`. This is used to filter the services by the precise `urn` of the Product Schema they have.

params.name: startMode
params.description:
This attribute is an enumerated integer that indicates how the 
Service is started, such as: 0: Unknown; 1: Automatically by 
the managed environment; 2: Automatically by the owning device; 
3: Manually by the Provider of the Service; 4: Manually by a 
Customer of the Provider; 5: Any of the above

params.name: offset
params.description: Requested index for start of item to be provided in response requested by client. Note that the index starts with "0".

params.name: limit
params.description: Requested number of items to be provided in response requested by client

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the Service instance

items.docs: This operation retrieves a service entity.
Sets the communication endpoint address the service instance must use to deliver information about its health state, execution state, failures and metrics.

params.name: id
params.description: Identifier of the Hub

items.docs: This operation retrieves a hub entity.

params.name: id
params.description: The id of the registered listener

items.docs: Resets the communication endpoint address the service instance must use to deliver information about its health state, execution state, failures and metrics.
